cache_relocation.consequence: a copied or moved cache is not reused; records are re-created after one trace per command
cache_relocation.note: TraceJIT hashes the inherited environment into the cache key, and TRACEJIT_CACHE_DIR is part of that environment: moving a cache directory invalidates every record in it. Measured directly in Phase AA.

methodology: Each arm is a session of N repeats in the same workspace. A scheduler that skips work and a cache that restores verified output are different mechanisms; each table states which one acted. An unavailable tool is never scored.

scenarios.claim: TraceJIT does not reuse make. The difference is the cost of tracing a command that is then refused, not a cache result.
scenarios.mechanism: build scheduler; TraceJIT refuses this command

scenarios.observed_output_semantics: Corrupting an output retraces for tools that read the existing output (gzip -f, bzip2 -f, objcopy, strip) and restores for tools that only create it (gcc). Both are correct; only the cost differs. Verified across the corpus's output_corruption decisions.
